verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੋਚਨ ਦਰਸ ਅਵਿਲੋਕ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: sees gur charan karan upadhes dheekhiaa lochan dharas avilok sukh paieeaai ||

en.bdb: O True Guru! be kind and let my head be in the feet of the True Guru, my ears be always attentive to listen to the words divine, my eyes be seeing your glimpse and thus bless me with true happiness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦ ਗੁਰ ਹਸਤ ਸੇਵਾ ਡੰਡੌਤ  ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਨ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: rasanaa sabadh gur hasat sevaa dda(n)ddauat  ridhai gur giaan unaman liv laieeaai ||

en.bdb: O True Guru! be kind and bless me that my tongue may ever repeat and utter the ambrosial words that Guru has blessed me with, the hands may indulge in the service and salutation, the words of wisdom may remain installed in my mind and thus fix my consciousness in higher state of spirituality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਗਵਨ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਰਕ੍ਰਮਾ ਲਉ  ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸਾਨ ਮਤਿ ਨਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan gavan saadh sa(n)gat parakramaa lau  dhaasan dhaasaan mat ni(n)mrataa samaieeaai ||

en.bdb: May my feet advance towards holy Sangat and circumambulate them, and thus absorb my mind in the humility possessed by slaves of the servants.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਰੇਨ ਮਜਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਭੋਜਨ ਦੈ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪੈਜ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਈਐ ॥੬੨੮॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)t ren majan bhagat bhaau bhojan dhai sree gur kirapaa kai prem paij pragaTaieeaai ||628||

en.bdb: O True Guru! enlighten in me the loving respect by Your grace, making me dependent upon those holy and noble souls whose support is Lord's name. Grant me their company and food of loving devotion to survive on.  (628)
